name: Experiment Metadata Fix — hook_formula + speaker + topic in experiments & publish-ledger
goal: Fix the Stage 9-experiment bundle lookup so hook_formula and speaker are never 'unknown'. Enrich publish-ledger entries with hook_formula, speaker, topic. Dashboard Panel 17 will then show real formula pass-rates.
rationale: All experiments.jsonl entries have hook_formula='unknown' and speaker='unknown'. Root cause: orchestrator Stage 9-experiment uses `bundles.find(b => b.clip_id === gate.video_id)` but gate.video_id is the editing-stage generated ID, not clip_id. Fix: look up via editedVideos[gate.video_id].insight_id → bundles[insight_id]. Also enrich publish-ledger with hook_formula, speaker, topic for Apr 7 gate analysis.
swarm: NOT USED — surgical edit to orchestrator (complex file). Writing directly.

tasks.title: agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts — fix Stage 9-experiment bundle lookup
tasks.description: In Stage 9-experiment: build editedMap (video_id → EditedVideo) from editedVideos. Then for each gate: `const edited = editedMap.get(gate.video_id); const bundle = bundles.find(b => b.insight_id === edited?.insight_id);` This replaces the broken `bundles.find(b => b.clip_id === gate.video_id)` lookup.

tasks.title: agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts — enrich publish-ledger entries
tasks.description: In Stage 9-publishing (after published videos are collected): when building publish-ledger entries, look up bundle via same editedMap+insight_id pattern and add hook_formula, speaker, topic fields to the ledger entry.

tasks.title: Smoke test — verify hook_formula and speaker are non-unknown in output
tasks.description: Run smoke test (npx ts-node scripts/orchestrate-agents-v2.ts --mode=mock). Check experiments.jsonl last N entries: hook_formula != 'unknown', speaker != 'unknown'. PASS = at least 5 entries with real values.
